reasoning: The icon combines a stopwatch body, camera aperture blades, and a plus sign, literally representing adding or increasing shutter speed, exposure time, or a camera timer/time-lapse. While distinctive once inspected, it fits a narrow niche of photography tasks (shutter speed, long exposure, intervalometer) and can look like a generic stopwatch or pie-sliced wheel at small sizes.
